scope: Add malformed OBJECTS-body frame recovery and CLI disposition controls for the bounded BLOCKREPRESENTATION_DATA profile.

source.kind: scratch-only DWGs authored at test runtime by the in-tree DWG writer
source.object: BLOCKREPRESENTATION_DATA with flag 7 and a hard-owner reference to the model-space BLOCK_RECORD; one-bit mutation is searched only after a valid common prologue and within the declared body span.

implementation.controls: Each source must read successfully with one object parse failure, zero entity parse failures, one failed frame, exact source-frame accounting, and a following LINE callback. Strict ASCII/Binary conversion preserves the destination sentinel. Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion succeeds, reopens with the retained LINE and VPORT, and carries the incomplete-output warning.

results.versionLimit: Valid AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 sources were generated, but the bounded one-bit body mutation search did not find a mutation that makes this parser reject. No malformed-body recovery claim is made for those revisions.

limitations: Generated parser-recovery and CLI disposition evidence only; it does not establish BLOCKREPRESENTATION_DATA producer semantics, arbitrary body corruption behavior, or interoperability.
The negative bit mutations are limited to AC1015/AC1018/AC1021; no failing AC1024+ mutation was found within this body-bounded search.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
